beats.spoken: Yeah. I got laid off too.
beats.broll: Headline montage from owner's screenshots (Microsoft, Amazon 30,000, trueup.io chart, AI blamed 1 in 5, LDS, Indonesia 50,000, layoffs.fyi), hard music stop, 0.45 s black, then FACE

beats.spoken: I'm Talal. I'm an AI engineer. I was working remotely from Lahore, Pakistan, for a company abroad. While doing my MS in AI at LUMS, in Lahore. Then one day, it was just… over. And honestly, I'm figuring out what comes next.
beats.broll: FACE for 'I'm Talal. I'm an AI engineer.' then: map zoom world → Pakistan, single pin on Lahore (🧑‍💻), dashed link to 'Remote team' → bubble flips to 🎓 → LUMS photo + name tag → link snaps, 'Your access has been removed' → search bar

beats.spoken: For years I've built AI systems. LLMs, RAG, agents. Turning ideas into real products. But they were always someone else's ideas. While I had a ridiculous number of my own sitting in my head.
beats.broll: Fast word stack + code on screen; last line on FACE; ideas.txt list filling up
beats.graphic: kinetic words: LLMs → RAG → Agents → Products

beats.spoken: So instead of waiting for the next opportunity… I'm going to build.
beats.broll: Laptop opens → idea written → code → deploy in terminal; 'I'm going to build' on FACE

beats.spoken: One: build products from scratch. The experiments, the failures, hopefully some launches. Two: AI. What I've learned, and what I'm learning. LLMs, RAG, research papers. Three: build in public. Everything that happens along the way.
beats.broll: 01: code + terminal + product UI · 02: arXiv papers, Hugging Face, RAG diagram · 03: GitHub, late-night desk, walking

beats.spoken: I have no idea where this is going to take me. But I'm going to document it.
Let's see what we can build.
beats.graphic: badge: Day 1 · end card: Talal Ahmed — AI Engineer → Builder

shot_list: FACE 1 (hook): 'Yeah. I got laid off too.', look down, then up into the lens. Record 3 energies: flat, tired smile, direct.
FACE 2 (context): 'I'm Talal. I'm an AI engineer.'
FACE 3 (realization): 'While I had a ridiculous number of my own sitting in my head.', small smile on 'ridiculous'.
FACE 4 (decision): pause 1 s, then 'I'm going to build.', flat and certain, not hype.
FACE 5 (payoff): 'I have no idea where this is going to take me. But I'm going to document it.', one continuous take.
VOICEOVER: record every other line on the mic (can be done at the desk, no camera).

caption_draft:
Yeah. I got laid off too.
AI engineer working remotely from Lahore, doing my MS in AI at LUMS. Now, instead of waiting for the next job, I'm going to build. Products, AI, and the whole messy journey. Day 1.
Follow along and let's see what we can build.
